definitions.selection: Only accepted=true, warmup=false; exactly five samples for each revision and workload. Interrupted, contaminated and extra recovery warmups remain in the raw manifest.
definitions.statistics: Median of each scalar metric across the five recorded samples; percentage changes use these medians. No aggregate 10% acceptance verdict is inferred.
definitions.retainedGrowth: Signed candidate median growth minus baseline median growth, divided by the baseline median pre-payload/starting physical footprint. Negative growth is preserved.
definitions.memory: Direct physical-footprint bytes, not node-count estimates. Coverage fixtures are synthetic canonical file identities, not an end-to-end application corpus.
definitions.cpu: Checkpoint acceptance cpuSeconds is same-thread worker CPU; enqueue/backlog and ingress cpuSeconds are process workload CPU. Navigation processCPUSeconds is process workload CPU and observationMetrics.cpuSeconds is same-thread observation CPU.
